definitions.access_demand: Successful foreground Session.get/batch_get outside planning; not equivalent to Visit or semantic necessity.
definitions.P: Distinct actual payload-returned keys by generation/request/session/UUID; repeated deliveries reported separately.
definitions.U: Explicitly named matching-demand or timely-use subset; never silently interchange intersection, post-batch demand, post-delivery demand and promotion.
definitions.unused: P minus successful demand in declared scope. Does not establish semantic not-needed or physical scan waste.
definitions.white_read: Operational unused and independently validated not-needed/filter-rejected candidates remain separate. Predicate/ownership graph reads may be necessary even if not output or visited.
definitions.coverage: Declare numerator/denominator explicitly; demand coverage and U/P usefulness are different. Policy filtering can change measured demand D. Preserve counts and uncovered D.
definitions.zero_denominator: Use null/N/A rather than 100 percent usefulness for P=0. Demand coverage can be zero if D>0.
definitions.aggregation: Request/session-local unique counts summed over workflow; ratio of totals differs from mean per-request ratios. Retain actual n and vectors.
definitions.SQL_wall: Observed sendall-to-ReadyForQuery protocol interval includes transport, server work and row decoding, not pure server CPU. Sum and union separate.
definitions.HTTP: Client response-read interval, explicit drain and setup/restart separate. Direct tracing remains instrumentation; precision instrumentation is separate and needs honest overhead/control scope.
definitions.GIL_thread: Actual server/worker runtime GIL-off evidence and same PID, distinct thread/backend for background SQL. Configuration/build label alone is insufficient.
